# Get Health Sample Detail

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about the given health sample.

## Syntax

~~~~text
sampleDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, sample: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
sampleDetail(detail: Type, sample: Daily Sample)
~~~~
